notes: s014-s015 בּוֹ → 'therewith' is one two-morpheme unit under rules 22 and 30, headed on the preposition since no relative stands in the phrase (rule 23); the suffix is not marked unrepresented, because the single English word carries the resumption as well as the relation.
s010's article takes the phrase's single written 'the', fronted because the rectum אָדָם is rendered anarthrously as 'of men' (rule 29).
